headline: Revenue stalls and profit falls; buyback expanded
summary_short: The Trade Desk's Q3 2026 revenue was $736 million, down 0.5% y/y, and adjusted EBITDA fell to $266 million from $317 million; it guided Q4 revenue of at least $755 million.
summary_long: Revenue slipped from $739 million while net income dropped to $38 million from $116 million, and adjusted EBITDA margin narrowed to 36% from 43%. The CEO said results were well ahead of the company's own expectations entering the quarter but growth remains below the level it expects. The company raised its repurchase authorization by $731 million to $1 billion in total. Fourth quarter outlook is revenue of at least $755 million and adjusted EBITDA of at least $280 million.
confidence_notes: KPIs are taken from the release's own table. The release gives no detailed cause for the revenue or margin change beyond the CEO's commentary. Q4 outlook (revenue at least $755M, adjusted EBITDA at least $280M) is stated in the release but not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Not explained in the release beyond the CEO saying growth is below the level the company expects from itself; actions include customer engagement, platform innovation and new measurement.
Not explained in the release; net income margin fell to 5% from 16% as adjusted EBITDA margin narrowed to 36% from 43%.
Management says Q3 was well ahead of its expectations entering the quarter and it is acting with greater urgency to improve the underlying trajectory.
